_comment: Example --grouping-map file for prep_niches_input.py. Maps every value your --celltype-col can take to a coarser bucket used as NICHES's sender/receiver identity (its `cell_types` argument). Delete the _comment key or leave it -- it's ignored. Copy this file, edit the keys/values to match your own --celltype-col values, and pass it with --grouping-map.
